items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer addresses the interviewee as 'Tudi Toetie'. The interviewee does not mention any other person named 'Tudi Toetie' in the provided context.

ctx.x: Okay. So what I wondered about was most of the books, Toetie, say that many of the New Orleans musicians leave in 1917, when Storyville, or the District, as it was called, closed. But you leave in '11. Was there more work in Chicago for you? Or, what?
When I left there, an agent come and got me to bring a band to Chicago, to play for May Elaine.
